text:
olivia (People Ops): Quick drop — created a set of 'snackable' feedback bites for self-reviews & manager notes. Short, copy-paste friendly. https://paste.example/snack-bites

olivia (People Ops): Format: 1-line achievement; optional 1-line context. Three buckets: metrics, behavior, enablement.

olivia (People Ops): EXAMPLES

- Metrics: "Lowered p95 latency by 28% via kernel tuning and batching."
  Context: "Led infra change and validated in prod; no customer regressions."

- Behavior: "Improved on-call handoff process to reduce misrouting."
  Context: "Drafted runbook and ran 2 training sessions for oncall rotation."

- Enablement: "Enabled Analytics to run A/B retrieval experiments by delivering a reusable prompt kit."
  Context: "Pack included docs and a CI check; used by 3 teams."

derek: Love it. Can you add a 'supported vs led' variant? Quick sentence.

olivia (People Ops): Yup — Added: "Supported rollout by pairing with primary owner; owned validation and docs." 

sara: Manager note suggestion: "Consistently meets deadlines and mentors peers; ready to expand scope." Short.

miguel: Add customer-first line: "Reduced wait time for customers by 1.5s; improved NPS for trial flows." 

anna (Manager): These are handy. Can we also have a one-liner for 'blocked but mitigated' scenarios? e.g., dependencies.

olivia (People Ops): Added: "Navigated cross-team blockers to deliver X by negotiating timelines and priorities." 

people-bot: Pin added to #people-ops by olivia (People Ops)

olivia (People Ops): Updated version pushed to paste link with v2. https://paste.example/snack-bites?v=2
